title: AKGEC MCA First Year Fee Structure 2026-27
text:
AKGEC MCA First Year Academic Fee Structure for 2026-27.
College fee total: Rs. 135956.
Registration: Rs. 1500.
Tuition and Development: Rs. 111256.
Medical: Rs. 1500.
Book Bank: Rs. 3200.
Activity Fee (One Time): Rs. 5000.
PDP Charges (One Time): Rs. 3500.
Career Planning and Placement (One Time): Rs. 5000.
Refundable Caution Money: Rs. 5000.
Separate university examination fee: Rs. 7500.
Separate university digital library fee: Rs. 1000.
University charges are payable separately when demanded.
Counselling deposit must be deducted from the college fee.
Fees are subject to change.
